commands.toggle_raw: JSON/XML viewer: switch between tree and raw text

enabled.label: Show JSON and XML as a tree
enabled.description: A JSON or XML document opened in a view is shown as a collapsible, searchable tree instead of plain text.
enabled.help: A JSON or XML document opened in a view shows as a collapsible, searchable tree instead of plain text, for API responses and feeds. Off shows the raw text.

maxBytes.label: Largest document (bytes)
maxBytes.description: A larger document stays plain text, with a notice. Default 20 MiB.
maxBytes.help: A document larger than this many bytes stays plain text with a notice, so a huge response cannot freeze the view. Example: 20971520 for 20 MiB.

defaultView.label: Open in
defaultView.description: Whether a document opens as a tree or as its raw text.
defaultView.help: Whether a document opens as a tree or as its raw text; the other view is one click away.

expandDepth.label: Levels open at first
expandDepth.description: How many levels of the tree are open when a document opens; large documents open fewer.
expandDepth.help: How many levels of the tree are open when a document opens; large documents open fewer. Example: 2.

theme.label: Colours
theme.description: Light or dark, or Automatic to follow the colour scheme of the view.
theme.help: The viewer's colours: light, dark, or auto to follow the colour scheme the view emulates.

viewer.label: JSON/XML viewer
viewer.budget: Only the first {count} rows were opened
viewer.badQuery: The query cannot be read at character {column}
viewer.tooLarge: This document has {size} - more than the viewer's limit of {limit}, so it stays plain text.
